meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 CDP 协议控制你已登录的 Chrome：打开网址、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、读取页面快照，并从 localStorage 或 cookie 里提取登录 token。若已有 Chrome 在运行，启动调试实例前会先征求你同意。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器操作”“CDP”等关键词，或需要复用已有登录态、从浏览器提取 token 时触发；前提是已装 Chrome 与 agent-browser。

say.text: 帮我在浏览器里打开这个网址，并把登录 token 取出来
say.note: 走 CDP 读取 localStorage 或 cookie

say.text: 先探测一下 9222 端口的 CDP 状态
say.note: 只探测，不改动任何状态

say.text: 打开页面后等 3 秒，再把正文文本前 8000 字给我

howto.what_en: Claude can drive your logged-in Chrome over CDP: open URLs, wait for load, run JavaScript, take page snapshots, and pull auth tokens from localStorage or cookies. If Chrome is already running, it asks your consent before launching the debug instance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention “browser automation”, “CDP”, “浏览器操作” and similar, or need to reuse an existing login session or extract a token from the browser. Requires Chrome and agent-browser installed.

say_en.text: Open this URL in the browser and pull the login token out
say_en.note: Uses CDP to read localStorage or cookies

say_en.text: First detect the CDP status on port 9222
Open the page, wait 3 seconds, then give me the first 8000 chars of body text
